fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-09-11, a rented premises near Vaigai Layout Market Road was allegedly occupied by a person after the lease ended, and the keys were not returned. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-09-04 at about 10:05. The complainant, Jagan Arumugam, provided the contact number 9000000008. Yuvaraj Palanisamy (9000000158) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complainant alleged that Chithra Kannan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000146. A further person, Vasanth Mani, a business acquaintance, using the number 9000000382, is stated to be associated with the incident. Items referenced in the complaint: photographs. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00189, as the mobile number 9000000146 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Occupant reportedly refused to vacate despite repeated requests.
fields.Keywords: illegal occupation, lease dispute, morning, mobile number, associate, photograph, witness, market road
